query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T00:00:00Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS failed = COUNT(*)
        BY day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp)
| SORT day ASC
